question: Does retaining transition targets during matched continuation training preserve a public state interface for long recursive reasoning better than encoder-and-consumer targets alone?

exploratory_seed.failed_check: transition minus mixed at horizon 16 was required to be at least 0.10 with a positive interval

pre_run_audit.loss_tokens: Each continuation arm has 20,000 one-token targets: 10,000 producer targets and 10,000 consumer targets.
pre_run_audit.compute: Each arm has 20,000 forwards and 5,120,000 fixed-padding tokens.
pre_run_audit.evaluation_harness: All arms use the same encoder, transition, and consumer prompts with a hard context cut between blocks.
pre_run_audit.public_code_contract: All arms receive the same fixed state-to-code map. Semantic accuracy scores either valid alias for a state; exact accuracy is reported separately.

cross_arm_substitution.conclusion: Swapping consumers does not reduce accuracy, so seed 1 does not support a private-code explanation.

independent_review: Claude Opus 5 rejected direct replication of the saturated transition-versus-mixed contrast, requested a loss-token audit and cross-arm substitution, and recommended a fresh-seed presence-versus-absence test with transition-versus-mixed equivalence kept separate.

data_contract.test_banks: The three 1,920-case test banks have distinct hashes and zero shared IDs.
data_contract.within_seed_pairing: Initial, transition, endpoint, and mixed arms share the exact test bank within each seed.
data_contract.continuation_pairing: Transition, endpoint, and mixed arms share exact train and validation program files within each seed.
data_contract.initial_curriculum: Initial adapters use one- and two-operation producer cases for two epochs.
data_contract.continuation_curriculum: Continuation arms use two-operation producer cases for one epoch.

treatments.transition: Every producer target maps a public input code plus two operations to the next public code.
treatments.endpoint: Every producer target maps a decimal start plus two operations to a public code; consumer targets stay unchanged.
treatments.mixed: A deterministic near-50/50 mix of encoder and transition producer targets; consumer targets stay unchanged.

primary.estimand: Across fresh seeds, horizon-16 closed-loop answer accuracy under mixed replay minus endpoint replay.
primary.analysis: Pair arms by exact item within a seed and cluster by the 30 held-out program contexts. Aggregate the three independent seed point estimates with a seed bootstrap and report every seed.

mechanism.estimand: Mixed minus endpoint forced-state-follow accuracy after a valid counterfactual code is inserted after block zero.

saturation_secondary.estimand: Horizon-16 transition replay minus mixed replay accuracy.
saturation_secondary.test: The aggregate 95% seed-bootstrap interval must lie within [-0.05, 0.05].

stopping_rule: Evaluate initial competence first. Launch continuation arms only for fresh seeds whose initial horizon-2 answer accuracy and gold-code consumer accuracy are each at least 0.95. Do not add horizons, change thresholds, or replace failed seeds after observing confirmation outcomes.

claim_boundary.in_scope: For this finite public code task and pinned Qwen receiver, matched post-training target allocation changes whether a learned interface remains reliable under repeated updates.
claim_boundary.out_of_scope: A universal law, a new transition-training method, unseen state-operation support, latent neural states, or natural-language reasoning in general. MuSiQue supplies separate natural-task evidence about decodability and reuse.
